contents.text:
The docs don't mention a Unity plugin. I searched for "Unity" and "game engine" and found nothing that describes one. So I can't say louis-agent ships one.

What the docs do cover is the hosts, the places an agent can meet people: the terminal, Rider, an HTTP API, and an MCP server. An HTTP API is one way a non-.NET program could reach an agent, but the docs don't describe a game integration.

The docs are the place to check, starting with the index. The features list is at `/features`, under "Where it runs".

choices.label: Show me the hosts
choices.why: The places an agent can meet people, including the HTTP API.

choices.label: Read the docs index
choices.why: See everything the docs cover, to check for yourself.

choices.label: Tell me what you're building
choices.why: I'll say which parts of the framework fit it.
